newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade hampered by weekend weather.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade hampered by weekend weather.

text.p: European meals and feeds closed with scattered neaby trades in rapemeal and Argentine soymeal but the prospect of changing weather forecasts over the weekend has already put consumers on the defensive here.
Traders said there was little chance of business picking up tomorrow ahead of the weekend, when either continued hot, dry weather or rainfall is expected to roil the market on Monday.
"When we could open either limit up or limit down on Monday, I can't see anybody taking a chance in this market. It's more like a casino," one trader commented.
